name: library-agent

dependencies.name: library-api
dependencies.description: Fetch available books for mood-based suggestions, and the caller's own loans for plain-language loan questions.

description: A single conversational agent for members: given a free-text mood description it suggests two or three available books with one-line reasons, and given a plain-language question about the caller's own loans it answers from that caller's real loan records fetched from library-api. Does not create, edit or remove books, and does not create or modify loans.
